memoryBuilder.verseText: Jesus said: 'I have shown you. Now do the same.'

sequence.prompt: What happened on the last evening? Put it in order.

items.label: They sat down to supper with dirty feet
Jesus wrapped a towel round His waist
He knelt and washed their feet
'Now do the same for each other'

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: It felt upside down — kings do not kneel
It means picking up the towel

application.question: Jesus did the job nobody wanted. Which job could you do for somebody today?
application.followUp: Jesus knew He was God's Son with everything in His hands — and He knelt on the floor anyway. He even washed the feet of the friend who let Him down that same night. First He makes us clean; then we copy Him. Jesus serves. I serve.
